title: ledger.py note only appends; no way to condense an over-long note list
observed: ledger.py note func_00159820 printed 'func_00159820 now has 5 notes; the target is at most 3 lines per function — condense at the next consolidate'. ledger.py --help lists no edit/replace/condense subcommand for notes, and 3 of the 5 are the same dsstep 0.1.0 'byte-identical resubmission' line repeated verbatim. K2 forbids hand-editing ledger/functions.jsonl, so the consolidate step the message points at has no tool to do what it asks.
expected: a consolidate step can condense a function's notes to the 3-line target with a script
hypothesis: the note-count warning was added without the matching editing command; the duplicate dsstep lines suggest the MatchRunner re-files the same note on each escalation instead of checking whether it is already present
